A Hyper Focal calculator is a useful tool for photographers who want to ensure that their photographs are in sharp focus from the foreground to the background. The Hyper Focal distance is the closest distance at which a lens can be focused while keeping the background in sharp focus.

By using a Hyper Focal calculator, a photographer can calculate the Hyper Focal distance based on the focal length of the lens, the aperture value, and the distance to the subject. Once the Hyper Focal distance is known, the photographer can adjust the focus to the Hyper Focal distance to ensure that everything from the foreground to the background is in sharp focus.

Additionally, the Hyper Focal calculator can also calculate the Near and Far Focus distances, which are the closest and farthest distances at which the lens can focus while still maintaining acceptable sharpness. Knowing these distances can help the photographer determine the appropriate focus distance for their specific situation.

In short, a Hyper Focal calculator can be a valuable tool for photographers who want to ensure that their photographs are in sharp focus from foreground to background, especially in landscape and architectural photography.

Puffin Cloud Browser is the client app that accesses the cloud server which runs the web browser. The Puffin client app and the Puffin cloud server do not communicate in HTTP protocol and the data exchange is not in HTML format. The Puffin client app is like the remote desktop client and the Puffin cloud server is like the remote desktop server. Puffin Cloud Browser gives the audience the illusion of a web browser but it is not, in reality, a web browser. Puffin Cloud Browser can only "display" the web content rendered on the cloud servers but can't "render" the web content itself on the client devices.

==== Differentiating Features ====
* Browser Isolation
* Cloud Acceleration
* Data Saving
* Download to Cloud
* Flash Game
* Full Desktop Mode
* Internet Access Protection
* Virtual Gamepad/Mouse/Trackpad

==== Important Limitations ====
* Only works on websites that are publicly accessible from the US
  -- Does not work for private IP, corporate Intranet, and geo-restricted websites
* Only works in countries that are not excessive in censorship
  -- Does not work in China, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates

* For some websites, Puffin server IP blocks need to be white-listed
  -- Puffin can bring an excessive load to some websites

More info at Puffin FAQ https://help.puffin.com/faq
